attributes.action: Discretionary leave for the world cup games!
attributes.additional_details: Alot of people dont get the chance to celebrate their national games because of having to work to pay the bills during the increase of cost. I think that overtime should be offered as an incentive for anyone that wants it, and anyone else who watches the games should be able to. Its a national sport and nearly everyone wants to support their team, offer overtime for people willing to work during the game as an incentive and allow those who want to watch it either time off or an extended break.
attributes.background: employees should have the time of the game off for every national game. Some people who want to celebrate their nation often dont get to because they have to work to make sure their family's get their monthly pay. Im asking for either time off or a break at work for everyone who wants to.

rejection.details: It is up to employers whether they want to offer discretionary leave or overtime for football games.
